[5:20PM] #Dopemu #Akowonjo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic moving both towards and away from Cement, extending from there down to Dopemu under the bridge and inwards towards Pako by Goye, is proceeding without any significant delays. Additionally, the route from Goye leading inwards towards Alimosho road, connecting with Moshalashi, is also clear at this time. 

Furthermore, the movement of vehicles from Dopemu by Swipha, going inwards towards Akowonjo roundabout and down to the intersection, and further towards Egbeda and Shasha, is also good. There are no reported impediments to traffic flow, and our officers are present and actively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
